sections.hook: What happens when you notation $\int_a^b f(x)dx$? Let's explore definite integrals in IGCSE Add Maths.
sections.core_explanation:
Definite Integrals

Notation $\int_a^b f(x)dx$ Fundamental Theorem of Calculus Evaluating $[F(x)]_a^b = F(b)-F(a)$ Properties of definite integrals Reverse limits $\int_b^a = -\int_a^b$ Zero-width interval $\int_a^a = 0$
